// Test Suite for VIRTUA-3.3

class TestVirtua3_3(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        # Setup for each test case
        self.system = System()
        self.chemist = Chemist()
        self.patient = Patient()
        self.payment_gateway = PaymentGateway()

    def test_system_self_contained(self):
        # Test that the system is self-contained
        self.assertTrue(self.system.is_self_contained())

    def test_chemist_login(self):
        # Test that chemists can log in
        self.chemist.login()
        self.assertTrue(self.chemist.is_logged_in())

    def test_patient_login(self):
        # Test that patients can log in
        self.patient.login()
        self.assertTrue(self.patient.is_logged_in())

    def test_email_prescription_invoice(self):
        # Test that only emails are sent with prescription and invoice
        self.patient.send_prescription()
        self.assertEqual(self.patient.email_received, True)

    def test_payment_interface(self):
        # Test the payment interface with the standard gateway
        self.payment_gateway.connect()
        self.assertTrue(self.payment_gateway.is_connected())

    def test_payment_button(self):
        # Test the payment button
        self.payment_gateway.click_payment_button()
        self.assertTrue(self.payment_gateway.is_button_enabled())

    def test_payment_methods(self):
        # Test payment methods
        self.payment_gateway.select_payment_method('Debit/Credit Card')
        self.assertTrue(self.payment_gateway.is_payment_method_enabled())
        self.payment_gateway.select_payment_method('Net Banking')
        self.assertTrue(self.payment_gateway.is_payment_method_enabled())

    def test_browser_support(self):
        # Test browser support
        self.assertTrue(self.system.is_browser_supported('Google Chrome'))
        self.assertTrue(self.system.is_browser_supported('Mozilla Firefox'))
        self.assertTrue(self.system.is_browser_supported('Safari'))

    def test_os_support(self):
        # Test OS support
        self.assertTrue(self.system.is_os_supported('Windows'))
        self.assertTrue(self.system.is_os_supported('macOS'))
        self.assertTrue(self.system.is_os_supported('Linux'))
